spans.s:
क्षोत्तृ m. A pestle, implement for
grinding.

क्षोदः [क्षुट्-घञ्]
1 Pounding,
grinding.
--2 The stone on which
anything is ground or powdered, a
mortar.
--3 Any ground substance, flour.
--4 Dust, particle, any small or
minute particle;

.
--Comp.
--क्षम a. capable of standing a test,
scrutiny or investigation.

क्षोदित a. [क्षुद्-णिच्-क्त] Pounded,
ground.
--तं
1 Powder, dust.
--2
Flour, any ground substance.

. (b)
Provocation, irritation; प्रायः स्वं
महिमानं क्षोभात्प्रतिपद्यते जंतुः Ś. 6. 30.

क्षोभणं [क्षुभ्-णिच् ल्युट्]
1 Agitating,
disturbing.
--णः One of the five
arrows of Kāmadeva.
--2 An epithet
of (a) Viṣṇu, (b) Śiva.

क्षोडः The post to which an
elephant is tied.

क्षोणिः, क्षोणी f.
1 The earth.
--2
The number ‘one’ (in math.).

क्षोणिः, क्षोणी f.
1 The earth.
--2
The number ‘one’ (in math.).

क्षोभ^1 &c. See under क्षुभ्.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,. note: badly placed diacritics.

क्षोमः, --मं [क्षु-मन्] A room on
the top of a house.
--मं Wove silk.

क्षोमः, --मं [क्षु-मन्] A room on
the top of a house.
--मं Wove silk.
